Type: metallic stoneware table vase
Use: holding flowers or stems; living room, dining room, bedroom, on a table, shelf or mantel
Style: mid-century modern, glam, modern
Materials: stoneware with shiny metallic glaze
Colors: gold
Shape: tall slightly tapered cylinder widening toward the base, subtle twisted faceted panels, round open mouth, slim
Feel: warm, luxe, polished
Goes with: walnut wood, black, white or green accents; mid-century, glam or modern rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Mid-Century Metallic Stoneware Vase, 11.8"H, Gold
product.description: Accent your home or office with this striking metallic-gold vase. Perfect on its own as an elegant centerpiece or as a container for flowers, this vase will perfectly complete your mid-century-modern home decor. 5.12" diameter x 11.8"H 100% stoneware This stoneware vase with metallic-gold finish can also hold water for fresh-cut flowers. Wipe clean with a soft, dry cloth.
